components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-action-primary { min-height: 3rem; padding: .7rem 1.3rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--silk, #22272a); border-radius: 0; background: var(--silk, #22272a); color: var(--phos, #6fe6a1); font: 800 .8rem/1.4 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: #000; } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #14507a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A bounded alternative without competing for primary emphasis.
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { min-height: 3rem; padding: .7rem 1.3rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--silk, #22272a); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--silk, #22272a); font: 800 .8rem/1.4 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-action-secondary:hover { background: var(--silk, #22272a); color: var(--bezel, #d9dbd4); } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #14507a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bench Navigation
components.description: Persistent orientation across one public instrument.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; padding: .8rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 2px solid #22272a; background: #d9dbd4; } .ds-nav a { color: #4c534f; font: 700 .76rem/1.4 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: #22272a; } .ds-nav .ds-current { color: #22272a; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #7c5410; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: .2em; }

components.name: Graticule Screen
components.description: A bounded proof surface for traces, states and addresses.
components.css: .ds-screen { margin: 0; } .ds-screen div { display: grid; gap: .75rem; padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem; border: 2px solid #263028; border-radius: 6px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, rgba(111,230,161,.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 10%), #0e1512; box-shadow: inset 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55); color: #6fe6a1; font: 700 .78rem/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-screen figcaption { margin-top: .9rem; color: #4c534f; font: 400 .86rem/1.6 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Calibration Record
components.description: Native disclosure for claim provenance and maturity.
components.html:
CAL / PROOF CURRENT

Mechanism, proof, source and action remain inspectable.
components.css: .ds-cal { border: 1.5px dashed #a7aba0; background: #f4f5f0; color: #22272a; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-cal summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; padding: .55rem .9rem; cursor: pointer; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-cal summary span { width: .6rem; height: .6rem; border: 1.5px solid #7c5410; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-cal[open] summary span { background: #e2a43e; } .ds-cal summary b { margin-left: auto; padding: .14rem .5rem; background: #1f6f43; color: #fff; font-size: .6rem; } .ds-cal p { margin: 0; padding: .9rem 1rem; border-top: 1px dashed #a7aba0; }

narrative.overview: Endroit presents itself as a precise instrument built by people who care how software is made. Warm steel is the work surface; silkscreen typography labels each bounded responsibility; dark graticule screens make system behavior observable rather than merely asserted.
keyCharacteristics: One warm work surface with bounded dark readouts.
Meaning expressed through traces, latches, states, addresses and exclusions.
Dense technical labels paired with plain-language consequences.
Static-first behavior with full no-JavaScript reading.

rules.name: Signal Has Meaning
rules.body: Never use phosphor, amber or alarm red as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: Readout Is Not the Message
rules.body: Monospace labels identify a signal or contract; they do not replace explanatory prose.

rules.name: Bounded Insert
rules.body: Dark material appears only as a screen, readout or control—not as the page background.

dos: Do make inclusion and exclusion equally inspectable.
Do preserve keyboard completion, visible focus, AA contrast, reduced motion and full no-JavaScript reading.
donts: Don't turn the Site into an IDE, fake terminal, decorative dashboard or all-dark developer template.
Don't add ornamental glows or accent colors without a semantic state.
Don't hide product claims behind interaction.
